about: Senior Flutter & Cross-Platform Software Engineer with over 4.5 years of hands-on experience building scalable, high-performance applications across Android, iOS, desktop, and web platforms. Proven expertise in architecting complex Flutter applications, handling real-time data, asynchronous workflows, advanced state management, and third-party integrations. Experienced in fintech, transportation, delivery, and enterprise systems, with a focus on clean architecture, performance optimization, and user-centric design.
